e-4437.problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\textbf{u}=\langle 1,2 \rangle$ and $\textbf{v}=\langle 3, -3 \rangle.$
e-4437.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & -3\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-3)-3\cdot 2 \\  & =-9\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $\det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A = |{-9}| = 9
$$

content.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ -4 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ -4 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot 3-5\cdot (-4) \\  & =23\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,23\,|=23
$$
